name: use-feedback
title: useFeedback
author: Eduardo Retana
description: One intent plays a cue, an optional haptic, and a motion hint. Sound and haptics stay independently mutable.

meta.descriptionEs: Un intento reproduce un cue, un háptico opcional y una pista de movimiento. Sonido y hápticos se silencian por separado.

examples.title: useFeedback
examples.description: Un intento reproduce un cue, un háptico opcional y una pista de movimiento. Sonido y hápticos se silencian por separado.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: 320px, texto largo, y lectura de derecha a izquierda.

api.name: trigger
api.description: tap, toggle, open, close, select, navigate, type, success, warning, error, loading, ready, attention, or confirm. Pass sound or haptic false to skip a channel.

api.name: motion
api.description: A short scale or shake. Duration is 0 when motion is reduced.

api.name: useFeedback
api.description: muted, reduced, trigger, and motion. Nothing runs on mount.

docs: Original wiring of ui-sounds and haptics. Reduced motion drops the animation hint only. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
